name: 2197-sampleddecode-llama31-8b-1gpu
model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct -- the ungated re-upload of the gated `meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct`, config.json matching field for field. ~16 GB of bf16 weights, already in the local HF cache.
hardware: 1x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3, one node, one GPU.
parallelism: tp1, one GPU, no collective communication.
architecture: LlamaForCausalLM, 32 layers, hidden 4096, intermediate 14336, 32 query heads over 8 KV heads (head dim 128), vocab 128256, 8.03B parameters, bf16, unquantized.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=32, warmup the first 20%, bounded at 640 requests with a 1800 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix structure: prompts centred on 512 tokens (stdev 64, clamped 384-768), generations pinned at exactly 1024 tokens with no spread, `temperature: 1.0`, `top_p: 1.0`, `ignore_eos: true`, seed 42 -- all declared in `scenario.json`.
purpose: A long-form creative writing assistant generating 1024-token drafts from short prompts for 32 concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
# Flat `key: value` only. An indented line is SKIPPED, so a nested block is dropped and the
# engine starts without the key it declares.

# NousResearch's ungated re-upload of `meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct` (Llama 3.1 Community
# License). Same weights, same config.
model-path: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
tp-size: 1

# The pre-scaling window, not the model's declared 131072. Prompt max 768 + output 1024 is
# 1792 tokens, so nothing is ever truncated.
context-length: 8192

mem-fraction-static: 0.85
random-seed: 42
